title: Dr. Anitha D B

Qualification

  2. Post-Graduation in “VLSI and Embedded system Design” at SJCE, Mysore affiliated to VTU in 2007.
  3. Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics and Communication Engineering, at PESCE, Mandya from University of Mysore in 2000.
